title: John 1:1 formula result: 2.7183E x 10^40, or e x 10^40
summary: Applies the formula (Number of Letters x Product of Letters) divided by (Number of Words x Product of Words) to John 1:1: (52 x 8,436,251,456,259,110 followed by zeros) divided by (17 x 949,302,241,399,839 followed by zeros) = 2.7183E x 10^40, written as log_e X x 10^40 or e x 10^40 (Euler's number).

text.text: (Number of Letters x Product of Letters)
(Number of Words x Product of Words)
= log_e X x 10^40   or   e x 10^40

numbers.note: result 2.7183E x 10^40, presented as e (Euler's number)

uncertain: The product of letters printed in the formula is 8,436,251,456,259,110 followed by 24 zeros (as on slide 106), which does not match the exact product; the end result 2.7183E x 10^40 is transcribed as shown.
